lessons: The trades themselves were not the main problem: fees of 4.07 came to more than 1.4x everything the winners made before costs (2.94), so position sizes were too small for the moves captured to survive the cost of trading.

fees.plain_english: Every buy and every sell costs 0.78% of the amount traded, so a complete trade must gain 1.56% before it breaks even. 4.07 paid in fees across 23 completed trade(s).
